class.name: VoxelMaterialPalette
class.brief_description: The configuration of a voxel world's materials.
class.description: VoxelMaterialPalette lists the properties of a [VoxelWorld4D]'s configurable materials (i.e. excluding built-ins like air). Currently this is just their colors.

method.name: get_material_color
method.description: Returns the color of the given material, or white if the palette has no entry for it.

members.member: The colors of the materials, indexed by material.
